press_references.value: Flagright joins forces with HitPay to boost security in SEA

press_references.value: Singapore Businesses Can Now Accept UPI Payments via HitPay

partnership_announcements.description: HitPay has partnered with NPCI International Payments Limited to integrate India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI) into its platform, allowing Singapore merchants to accept UPI payments for in-store and e-commerce transactions.

overview_description.description: HitPay is a full stack payments infrastructure platform designed for growing businesses in APAC. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore, HitPay unifies e-commerce, point of sale, and B2B payments into a single platform. The company is regulated in 6 APAC jurisdictions and backed by leading global investors, including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Global Founders Capital, and HOF Capital.

about_short_description.short_description: HitPay is a full stack payments infrastructure platform designed for growing businesses in APAC.

product.name: Online Payments
product.description: A payment gateway and hosted checkout for accepting cards, bank transfers, QR payments, e-wallets, and buy-now-pay-later methods through websites, apps, and payment links.

product.name: Point of Sale
product.description: Cloud-based POS software for processing in-person payments, managing products and inventory, tracking sales, and synchronizing activity across physical and online channels.

product.name: Cross-Border Payments
product.description: A payment service for accepting international customers’ local cards, QR schemes, and e-wallets online, in stores, and through recurring billing workflows.

product.name: Payment Links
product.description: No-code, shareable payment pages that let businesses collect one-time or recurring payments through email, messaging apps, social media, QR codes, or other online channels.

product.name: Recurring Billing
product.description: Automated subscription and membership billing for setting payment plans, charging customers on scheduled cycles, tracking payment status, and retrying failed payments.

product.name: Invoicing
product.description: Digital invoicing software for creating branded invoices, accepting online payments, tracking balances, sending reminders, and supporting taxes, discounts, partial payments, and recurring invoices.
